points: Employment aged 20-29 fell about 3% from 2022 to 2025; ages 40-64 under 1%
AI-exposed occupations grew about 2% for workers 30+, but fell 3.8% for ages 20-29
Significant negative AI link only in manufacturing (about -6%) and non-academic jobs; descriptive, not causal
read: IAB-Forum article by Arntz, Dinelli and Schlenker, 13 October 2026 (Federal Employment Agency data 2021-2025)
take: Admin data on 22 million German workers shows AI-exposed jobs grew slightly since 2022. Weak hiring of under-30s is mostly the downturn; plan junior pipelines deliberately.
title: IAB: AI is no job killer yet, but young entrants lose ground
